description: This file defines a generic internal class LogViewAdaptor in C#, which acts as an adaptor for log views in an Orleans-based event sourcing system. It manages reading and writing log entries, batching updates, handling notifications, and integrating with storage and consistency protocols.

classes.name: LogViewAdaptor`2
classes.description: A generic internal class acting as a log view adaptor, managing log storage interactions and notifications.

classes.name: UpdateLogStorageFailed
classes.description: Serializable class representing failure to write log to storage.

classes.name: ReadFromLogStorageFailed
classes.description: Serializable class representing failure to read log from storage.

classes.name: UpdateNotificationMessage
classes.description: Serializable notification message disseminated after log updates, containing version, origin, log entries, and e-tag.

methods.description: Retrieves a segment of log entries between specified versions.
